theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: This is the only eligible theme combining trend health (hurst_tag=trend), high durability (0.83), and full breadth (1.0) — it is the headline and the staying-power candidate. The trend-gate leg (the one validated edge) is ON for this theme, and crowding is absent (z=0.14, not crowded), so no de-risk caution applies. I lean overweight as a durable-income expression while the gate stays on.
